title: Rocks & Geology
blurb: Rocks, gems, fossils, caves, and the plates that move our world.

hr.title: Stijene i geologija
hr.blurb: Stijene, dragulji, fosili, špilje i ploče koje pomiču naš svijet.

questions.q: What is the hardest mineral on the Mohs scale?
questions.fact: German scientist Friedrich Mohs created his 1-to-10 hardness scale in 1812.

hr.q: Koji je najtvrđi mineral na Mohsovoj ljestvici?
hr.fact: Njemački znanstvenik Friedrich Mohs napravio je svoju ljestvicu tvrdoće od 1 do 10 godine 1812.

questions.q: What is the softest mineral on the Mohs scale?
questions.fact: Talc is a 1 on the scale. It is so soft you can scratch it with your fingernail.

hr.q: Koji je najmekši mineral na Mohsovoj ljestvici?
hr.fact: Talk ima ocjenu 1. Toliko je mekan da ga možeš zagrebati noktom.

questions.q: True or false: Each step on the Mohs scale is the same jump in hardness.
questions.fact: Diamond is a 10 and corundum is a 9, but diamond is several times harder.

hr.q: Točno ili netočno: svaki korak na Mohsovoj ljestvici jednak je skok u tvrdoći.
hr.fact: Dijamant je 10, a korund 9, ali dijamant je nekoliko puta tvrđi.

questions.q: Which kind of rock forms when melted rock cools and hardens?
questions.fact: Igneous comes from the Latin word for fire.

hr.q: Koja vrsta stijene nastaje kad se rastaljena stijena ohladi i stvrdne?
hr.fact: Na engleskom se zovu 'igneous', od latinske riječi za vatru.

questions.q: What are scientists who study fossils called?
questions.fact: Fossils include more than bones. Footprints, shells, and leaf prints in rock count too.

hr.q: Kako se zovu znanstvenici koji proučavaju fosile?
hr.fact: Fosili nisu samo kosti. Računaju se i otisci stopala, školjke i otisci lišća u stijeni.

questions.q: What are the giant moving pieces of Earth's outer shell called?
questions.fact: Plates move only a few centimeters a year, about as fast as your fingernails grow.

hr.q: Kako se zovu golemi pomični dijelovi Zemljine vanjske ljuske?
hr.fact: Ploče se pomiču samo nekoliko centimetara godišnje, otprilike brzinom kojom ti rastu nokti.

questions.q: In a cave, where do stalactites hang from?
questions.fact: Memory trick: stalactites hold tight to the ceiling, and stalagmites grow up from the ground.

hr.fact: Stalaktiti vise sa stropa, a stalagmiti rastu s poda prema gore. Kad se spoje, nastaje stup.

questions.q: A ruby is a red form of which mineral?
questions.fact: Blue corundum is called sapphire. Rubies and sapphires are both a 9 on the Mohs scale.

hr.q: Rubin je crveni oblik kojeg minerala?
hr.fact: Plavi korund zove se safir. Rubini i safiri imaju ocjenu 9 na Mohsovoj ljestvici.

questions.q: What tool records the shaking from earthquakes?
questions.fact: Seismographs are so sensitive that they can pick up earthquakes on the other side of the world.

hr.q: Koji uređaj bilježi podrhtavanje tla pri potresu?
hr.fact: Seizmografi su toliko osjetljivi da mogu zabilježiti potrese s druge strane svijeta.

questions.q: Purple amethyst is a type of which mineral?
questions.fact: Quartz is a 7 on the Mohs scale, so it can scratch glass.

hr.q: Ljubičasti ametist vrsta je kojeg minerala?
hr.fact: Kvarc ima ocjenu 7 na Mohsovoj ljestvici, pa može zagrebati staklo.
